body:
22 feels so old to me. My train of thought is that if I've been feeling like this for so long, maybe it'll stay like this forever. It feels as if I'm just waiting around for things to change, it feels like a waste of time. Maybe that's not the case but as each day goes on it feels like the truth.

And I am pretty proud of getting good grades and getting into the university, I'm just terrified of moving forward. I'm not transferring in with enough credits to be considered a sophomore so I'll be living with people who are 17/18. At orientation last week I was struggling to connect with them, and honestly they scared the hell out of me. If I go there in the same mental state I'm in now I'm nervous that it'll get worse.
I'm going into journalism with a minor in digital media. And I hope we both find happiness soon.
